planets.name: HD 35843 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 35843 with a 47-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: HD 35843 c was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around HD 35843. Its orbit and size follow Hesse et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
